title: Value of the Moved Input Head
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $p$ be a head position among $0,\ldots,n+1$, and let $mv\in\{-1,0,1\}$. The value of the clamped input-head movement is $p$ when $mv=0$, is $p+1$ when $mv=1$ and $p\ne n+1$, and is $p$ when $mv=1$ and $p=n+1$; when $mv=-1$, it is $\max(p-1,0)$.
